content: Market Intelligence for YAL.ai: Unlocking Opportunities in AI Cybersecurity ABSTRACT： This thesis delves into the critical aspects of market intelligence for YAL.ai, a company seeking to leverage Artificial Intelligence in the cybersecurity domain within South Africa. Avoid abstract discussions about neural networks and instead focus on the outcome. During a POC, isolate a specific example of a sophisticated BEC attack that YAL.ai caught. Walk the CISO through the attack's anatomy and explain why their existing rule-based and reputation-based systems missed it.
